name: c-tests
cmd: bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null 2>&1 && . research/langs/c/clang-setup.sh && cd core && timeout -s KILL 500 bun test extract-c.test.ts 2>&1 | grep -v "^cyclic:" | tail -60

name: c-build-smoke
cmd: bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null 2>&1 && if command -v clang; then echo 'clang present: not shadowed'; exit 1; fi; echo 'no clang (shadowed)'; command -v node >/dev/null || { curl -fsSL https://nodejs.org/dist/v22.11.0/node-v22.11.0-linux-x64.tar.xz | tar xJ -C /opt && export PATH=/opt/node-v22.11.0-linux-x64/bin:$PATH; }; node --version; timeout -s KILL 500 sh scripts/smoke.sh > /tmp/smoke.log 2>&1; e=$?; tail -15 /tmp/smoke.log; echo "smoke exit $e"

name: c-identity-rb
cmd: bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null 2>&1 && . research/langs/ruby/ruby-setup.sh && cp -r research/langs/ruby/rules /tmp/rb-before && timeout -s KILL 900 bun research/langs/ruby/run.ts --write 2>&1 | tail -25; diff -r /tmp/rb-before research/langs/ruby/rules && echo 'RUBY RULES IDENTICAL'

name: c-identity-ex
cmd: bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null 2>&1 && . research/langs/elixir/elixir-setup.sh && cp -r research/langs/elixir/rules /tmp/ex-before && timeout -s KILL 900 bun research/langs/elixir/run.ts --write 2>&1 | tail -25; diff -r /tmp/ex-before research/langs/elixir/rules && echo 'ELIXIR RULES IDENTICAL'

name: c-identity-litellm
cmd: set -o pipefail; cd /tmp && git clone -q --depth 1 --branch ${LITELLM_REF:-v1.106.6} ${LITELLM_REPO:-https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm} litellm && cd litellm && git rev-parse HEAD && pip install -q uv >/dev/null 2>&1 && timeout -s KILL 600 uv pip install --system -q -e '.[proxy]' 2>&1 | tail -5; python3 -c 'import litellm.proxy.auth.auth_checks' && cd /work/gdp-wired && bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null 2>&1 && cp -r research/langs/litellm/rules /tmp/ll-before && timeout -s KILL 1200 bun research/langs/litellm/run.ts --src /tmp/litellm --ms 60000 --write --json /tmp/litellm-py.json; echo '--- json'; cat /tmp/litellm-py.json; for f in research/langs/litellm/rules/*.ts; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done; diff -r /tmp/ll-before research/langs/litellm/rules && echo 'LITELLM RULES IDENTICAL'

name: c-corpus
cmd: bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null 2>&1 && . research/langs/c/clang-setup.sh && cp -r research/langs/c/rules /tmp/c-before && timeout -s KILL 800 bun research/langs/c/run.ts --write 2>&1 | grep -v '^cyclic:' | tail -40; diff -r /tmp/c-before research/langs/c/rules && echo 'C RULES IDENTICAL'
